outputs.truth_sql: SELECT r FROM (SELECT s.name_en AS n, rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(a.pm2_5) DESC) AS r FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE a.datetime >= '2025-01-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.name_en HAVING avg(a.pm2_5) IS NOT NULL) t WHERE n = 'Yuen Long'

tasks.question: Pooling all hourly readings in December 2025, what was the mean PM2.5 at roadside stations, at general stations, and how much higher (or lower) was roadside than general?

outputs.desc: mean PM2.5 over all roadside-station hours, ug/m3
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT round(avg(a.pm2_5)::numeric, 2) FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.station_type = 'ROADSIDE' AND a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01'

outputs.desc: mean PM2.5 over all general-station hours, ug/m3
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT round(avg(a.pm2_5)::numeric, 2) FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.station_type = 'GENERAL' AND a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01'

outputs.desc: roadside_mean minus general_mean
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT round(((SELECT avg(a.pm2_5) FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.station_type = 'ROADSIDE' AND a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01') - (SELECT avg(a.pm2_5) FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.station_type = 'GENERAL' AND a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01'))::numeric, 2)

tasks.question: At the Causeway Bay air quality station, how much higher was the average NO2 in January 2025 than in December 2025? (A negative number if it was lower.)

outputs.desc: mean NO2 in January 2025 minus mean NO2 in December 2025, ug/m3
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT round((avg(a.no2) FILTER (WHERE a.datetime >= '2025-01-01' AND a.datetime < '2025-02-01') - avg(a.no2) FILTER (WHERE a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01'))::numeric, 2) FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.name_en = 'Causeway Bay' AND ((a.datetime >= '2025-01-01' AND a.datetime < '2025-02-01') OR (a.datetime >= '2025-12-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01'))

tasks.question: At the Tseung Kwan O air quality station in 2025, on how many days did the daily average PM2.5 exceed 25 ug/m3, and what was the highest daily average?

outputs.desc: number of calendar days with daily mean PM2.5 above 25
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT avg(a.pm2_5) AS m FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.name_en = 'Tseung Kwan O' AND a.datetime >= '2025-01-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', a.datetime)) t WHERE m > 25.0

outputs.desc: highest daily mean PM2.5, ug/m3
outputs.truth_sql: SELECT round(max(m)::numeric, 2) FROM (SELECT avg(a.pm2_5) AS m FROM hourly_station_air_quality a JOIN air_quality_station s ON s.id = a.station_id WHERE s.name_en = 'Tseung Kwan O' AND a.datetime >= '2025-01-01' AND a.datetime < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('day', a.datetime)) t
